correctness.rationale: Exact Gaussian covariance and Schur complement produce the objective; explicit positive all-ratio non-collocation gap, global uniform asymptotic bound, rigorous localization of every maximizer, local negative-definite Hessian plus symmetry, and stationary-point expansions yield the theorem. value.rationale: The theorem identifies a natural limitation of co-locating evaluations in the smallest nontrivial multifidelity Bayesian integral design. It establishes a globally valid strict separation, an exact golden-ratio limiting low-fidelity placement, and a nonzero quantified improvement that persists as discrepancy variance grows. This is a structural and nontrivial design characterization, not a routine known-table evaluation or arbitrary numerical slice.
